No, I can’t look at any one company’s flights. My job is just to keep the airspace info up to date—like closures, zones, and corridors—and make sure everyone sees the same picture. If a closure happens, I can tell you how many customers were affected in total, but not which ones or how many drones were delayed.

The companies handle their own operations, and I don’t have access to their flight data. If you need details on a specific company’s impact, you’d have to ask them directly.
